slices.title: Patch unresolvable MinIO Docker image tag
slices.jtbd: When implementing the MinIO image fix for this epic, I want to replace the failing tag with a known-good release, so that technical debt is eliminated and infrastructure standards are strictly upheld.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a docker-compose.yml file with an unresolvable MinIO image tag,
When the docker-compose config is loaded and the image is pulled,
Then the MinIO image tag is valid and resolvable, confirming a successful container pull.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unresolvable docker image startup failures from 1 to 0
